UPDATE: Makati air quality bumuti na—nasa GOOD to FAIR levels as of 1:30 AM (Apr 27).

Manatiling alerto sa updates at sa sitwasyon ng sunog sa Navotas landfill na maaaring makaapekto muli sa hangin.

#AirQualityUpdate #Makati #StaySafePH https://t.co/L2LfhK8wjR

data.raw_text:
The Manila City government on Monday advised its residents anew to wear face masks amid the “very unhealthy” air quality due to the massive fire at the Navotas Sanitary Landfill.

Click the photo to read more: https://t.co/j4r2KHedU8
